from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCategoryMapping(BaseModel):
    """A record linking a judgment document to its assigned legal cause category (案由)."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document found in the text (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_category: str = Field(description="The legal cause category (案由) the document is classified under")
    evidence_quote: str | None = Field(default=None, description="A short text snippet from the document that explicitly identifies the cause category")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all document-to-category mappings identified in the collection."""
    mappings: list[DocumentCategoryMapping]
